   922→    pub fn update_max_concurrent_executions(&self, current_concurrent: u32) {
   923→        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
   924→        let mut current_max = self.execution_stats.max_concurrent_executions.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
   925→        while current_concurrent > current_max {
